about_the_game:
【Attention】

On the Mac version, due to system specifications, it may take around 30 seconds for the game to launch (until the initial screen appears).
(This may vary depending on your system environment.)
Please wait until the launch screen appears.

Vampdoll: The Blood-Drinking Maidens

...They are girls who can only survive by drinking the blood of other girls.

To exterminate the grotesque beings known as "Werewolves",

they fight under the code name "Stray Dog Carnage".

As their "rations", they are provided with girls known as "Bride Thorns".

About the Game

This game is a "yuri" girls' love story, where you witness the emotions between girls who have become vampires and their human partners.

What endings will they each choose...?

There is only one ending. (With some minor branches.)

● What Are Vampdoll and Bride Thorn:

A Vampdoll is a “monster” that survives by drinking the living blood of young girls.
They lurk in the darkness, abducting girls and bringing about their deaths—
and have long been feared by society as such beings.

However, Vampdolls are not born monsters.
They are victims of a disease—once, they were ordinary girls like any other.
When the illness manifests, the urge to drink blood becomes uncontrollable,
leading them to be persecuted and cast out by society.

With nowhere left to go, these girls are taken in by the military,
and due to their extraordinary physical abilities,
are forced to fight massive beasts known as Werewolves……

The military then gathers orphaned girls
and provides them to the Vampdolls
as rations for battle……

A girl persecuted as a “monster,”
and a girl who has lost her place in the world.
As the two meet, clash, and—awkwardly—forge a bond,
their story unfolds as a Girl Meets Girl tale.

● Feature 1:

Each Vampdoll is paired with a girl known as a Bride Thorn, serving as her partner.
Sometimes assigned by the military,
sometimes chosen by the Vampdoll herself.

● Feature 2:

After battle, a Vampdoll must drink blood from her Bride Thorn.
To ease the pain, the act of bloodsucking is accompanied by heightened physical and emotional arousal.

＊This work is entirely fictional and bears no relation to any real persons, organizations, or events.
＊This game contains depictions of bloodshed, combat, violence, and emotionally charged romantic themes.
＊It also includes romantic relationships between women.

Synopsis

The era is Meiji.

Sana Shirafuji, who lost her grandmother and is left alone in the world,

knocks on the military's door to become a "Bride Thorn" to make a living.

A "Bride Thorn" is a "ration" for girls known as "Vampdolls",

who are specialized in combat.

Unaware of this, Sana accepts the military contract out of desperation.

On her first day of enlistment, she meets

Yukine Hanafusa, a beautiful yet disdainful Vampdoll.

Born into a noble family, yet cursed from birth as a Vampdoll,
Yukine is persecuted and reviled as a “monster.”
Shunned even by her own family,
she loathes her bloodthirsty impulses and keeps others at a distance—
rejecting Sana as well.

Yet, little by little, Sana and Yukine open their hearts to one another.
On the night of their first bloodsucking,
they are startled to learn that the act brings heightened physical and emotional sensations.
Awkward as they are, the two nonetheless share their first experience of bloodsucking together.

Not long after that,
during a certain operation, Yukine is rendered unable to fight.
Standing in their way as an enemy
is Satsuki—once, a trusted comrade……。

Highlights

  • Diverse graphics by manga artist Saku Takano.

  • A story that captures the delicate emotions of the girls.

  • A pure love girls' love story with the concept of "Vampires x Military Uniforms x Yuri".

Notice Regarding Monitor Refresh Rate

This game is designed to run in a 60Hz display environment.
If your monitor’s refresh rate is set to something other than 60Hz,
we kindly ask that you switch it to 60Hz before playing.

(For example, when using 120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz,
you may experience screen stuttering or visual instability.)

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

content_descriptors.notes: Some scenes in the game will contain violence and sexually suggestive content that is not suitable for minors. Please decide whether to play or not.
